summary: Secluded bush edge, but a through road with no parking and no pull-off.
reasons: Through road, no cars parked along it
Bush meets the road edge, no pull-off

drivers.seclusion: Bush on the east side; apartments and a gravel strip are 34 m or more away across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Two-lane sealed road with centre line and no shoulder on this side; scrub and trees grow to the edge, so a van would stand in the lane.
drivers.traffic: Through route linking the river-front apartments to Meiers Road; no parked cars in either image.
drivers.convention: No parking convention seen; no signs mapped.

flags: Low-lying: 4-6 m elevation, waterway 14 m away, flood-prone
Slope about 2% overall, steeper at the ends
sun_shade: Dense bush canopy shades the east side from the afternoon sun.
